title: FrankenSymPy shared conformance verdict record
description: One NDJSON verdict record from EITHER differential lane: the Python conformance laboratory (tools/conformance-lab, lane 'python_lab') or the Rust native-math corpus (crates/fsym-conformance, lane 'rust_native'). One shared verdict vocabulary and field space so drift counts are comparable across lanes (fra-conformance-corpus-200-b75). Producers must emit exactly these fields; consumers reject unknown fields (fail closed).

id.description: Fixture or case id within the lane's corpus.

lane.description: Which differential lane produced the record.

verdict.description: Shared verdict vocabulary. ExpectedRefusal is NEVER a pass; oracle failures are evidence, never a pass.

comparator.description: Registry id of the comparator that produced this verdict (e.g. exact_surface, construction_only, native_math_exact).

detail.description: Bounded diagnostic; null when the verdict needs no explanation.

expected.description: rust_native lane only: the oracle's exact string answer for the case; null elsewhere.
